2607.21574.title: Surprisal Theory is Tautological (without Rational Grounding)
2607.21574.paper_summary: Surprisal theory holds that the human processing difficulty of a linguistic unit in context is an affine function of its surprisal under some language model. I argue this claim is a tautology without further constraint: for any non-negative difficulty measure over units in context, there exists a language model whose surprisal is an affine function of it under mild technical conditions. Therefore, because any pattern of difficulty is consistent with some language model, without an additional constraint on the language model, surprisal theory makes no falsifiable predictions. The tautology was long obscured by an assumption implicit in two decades of psycholinguistic work---that the relevant language model is the distribution that generated the training corpus, so that improving corpus fit improves predictions of human behavior. Recent empirical work has undermined this assumption, demonstrating that better corpus models can be worse predictors of processing difficulty. I conclude that breaking the tautology requires a rationalist intervention, i.e., the relevant language model must be derived from a non-empirically motivated model of the comprehender, which could be based on, for instance, memory constraints or processing goals, and that, thus, does not depend on the behavioral data surprisal theory is meant to explain.
2607.21574.paper_summary_zh: 驚訝理論認為，語言單位在上下文中的人類處理困難度是其在某種語言模型下驚訝度的仿射函數。我主張這一說法是一種同義反復，沒有進一步的約束：對於上下文中的單位的任何非負困難度度量，存在一個語言模型，其驚訝度在輕微的技術條件下是其仿射函數。因此，由於任何困難度模式都與某種語言模型一致，若沒有對語言模型的額外約束，驚訝理論不會提出可證偽的預測。這一同義反復長期以來被一個隱含在二十年心理語言學工作中的假設所掩蓋——即相關的語言模型是生成訓練語料庫的分佈，因此改善語料庫擬合會改善對人類行為的預測。最近的實證研究削弱了這一假設，證明更好的語料模型可能會對處理困難度的預測效果更差。我得出結論，打破同義反復需要一種理性干預，即相關的語言模型必須源自一個非經驗性驅動的理解者模型，這可能基於例如記憶限制或處理目標，因而不依賴於驚訝理論旨在解釋的行為數據。
2607.21574.author: Ryan Cotterell et.al.
